title: fix(data-objectstack,app-shell): Publish all publishes each bundle member of a package-less draft by its own ?member= (objectui#12402)
body:
Fixes #12402
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What this does

"Publish all" (Home's banner and the draft-preview bar, both `usePublishAllDrafts`) now publishes each language of a package-less `email_template` by its own bundle member.

- `MetadataClient.publishDraft(type, name, options?)` in `@object-ui/data-objectstack` takes an optional `{ member }`. When it is set, the request is `POST /meta/TYPE/NAME/publish?member=VALUE`. When it is not set or is empty, no parameter is sent. The param-building shape is the one `reset()` uses (PR #12396). The wire spelling `member=` and its `encodeURIComponent` encoding match the by-name reads in `DraftChangesPanel` / `fetchItemBody` (PR #12400).
- `usePublishAllDrafts` keeps each `listDrafts()` row's `member` when it is a non-empty string. On the package-less path it calls `client.publishDraft(type, name, { member })` for a member row and `publishDraft(type, name, {})` otherwise.
- Package-bound drafts still go through `publishPackageDrafts(packageId)`. That path is unchanged.

## Public-surface change, for the contract review

- **Widened:** one exported method, `MetadataClient.publishDraft`. It gains an optional third parameter `options: { member?: string } = {}`. The return type is unchanged. Every existing call has two arguments and sends exactly the URL it sent before: pinned as "keeps the two-argument call byte for byte".
- **Unchanged:** every other `MetadataClient` method, `MetadataDraftHeader`, the advisory event shape (`emitAdvisories` still names `type` and `name` only), and the batch door.
- **Wire contract it follows, read upstream (read-only):** objectstack `038d4c958` (ruling 6116165299 on objectstack#22877). `POST /meta/:type/:name/publish` has the closed query set `package`, `member`. An absent selector means the canonical member. A blank selector, or any selector on a type with no discriminator (every type but `email_template`), is a located 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`. So the client sends the parameter only when the caller has a member. It never sends an empty one, and the hook never makes one up for a member-less row.
- **Source of `member`:** the installed `@objectstack/spec` `18.0.0-next.1` declares `ListDraftsResponseSchema.drafts[].member` as `z.ZodOptional` of `z.ZodString`, read from its `dist` `.d.ts`.

## Premise measurements (dispatch assumptions)

- A1, held. The hook mapped rows to `{ type, name, packageId }` and dropped `member`. The package-less loop called `client.publishDraft(d.type, d.name)`.
- A2, held. `publishDraft` took no member and sent no query string.
- A3, nothing to change. The hook has no result de-duplication and no toast or progress keyed on `type` + `name`. The one per-item string (`NAME: sample data failed to load`) is for `seed` drafts, which carry no member. `lintDraftCapabilityReferences` receives the rows but lints only `object`, `app` and `action`, which never carry a member.

## Tests

Tree `062328bf6`.

- New `packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.publishDraftMember-12402.test.ts` (5 cases):
  - a member is sent as `?member=`;
  - two members of one name go to two URLs;
  - absent, `{}`, an empty string and `undefined` send no parameter;
  - the two-argument call is byte for byte what it was;
  - encoding.
- New `packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/usePublishAllDrafts.bundleMember-12402.test.tsx` (3 cases). This is the card's pins, through the real hook, `useMetadataClient` and `MetadataClient`, with `fetch` stubbed:
  - two package-less members of one `email_template` publish with `?member=en-US` and `?member=zh-CN`;
  - a member-less `flow`, and a row with an empty `member`, send no selector;
  - package-bound members go through one `publish-drafts` call and get no by-name publish, while a package-less member beside them gets its own `?member=`.
- Results under the verify lock:
  - `vitest run packages/data-objectstack/ packages/app-shell/src/preview/`: `Test Files 115 passed (115)`, `Tests 1316 passed (1316)`.
  - The two new files alone: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 8 passed (8)`.
- Hook consumers (`packages/app-shell/src/console/home/__tests__/` and `useMetadataClient.advisorySink.test.tsx`): `Test Files 22 passed (22)`, `Tests 134 passed (134)`. This ran **outside** the lock with `--maxWorkers=1`, a declared narrowing: two 9-minute lock waits timed out (exit 99) behind a full `packages/app-shell/` run.
- **NOT MEASURED: the full app-shell vitest project.** One lock attempt was cut off by the foreground cap after a 4.5-minute queue. The later waits timed out as above. This is declared to CI.

### Ablation (one-off, through `ablation-replace.mjs`)

- The run went through `node ablation-replace.mjs` from the objectstack checkout.
- **Mutation:** in `usePublishAllDrafts.ts`, the argument `d.member ? { member: d.member } : {}` was replaced with an empty object carrying a marker comment. Anchor count went 1 to 0, the marker 0 to 1, and the blob `fec8eed29b27` to `308438498f04`.
- **Result:** `Tests 2 failed | 1 passed (3)`. The two-members pin and the package-bound-plus-package-less pin went red. The member-less pin stayed green. That is the predicted direction.
- **Restore:** the blob equals HEAD `fec8eed29b27` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- The first attempt used a replacement already present in the file. The tool refused it as a no-op (replacement count 3 to 3) and restored it before running anything. It is not counted as an ablation run.
- The mutated file is app-shell source imported relatively by the test, so no `dist` rebuild was involved.

## Changeset

`.changeset/12402-publish-all-member.md`:

- `@object-ui/data-objectstack` is `minor`, an additive widening of a published method. objectui never declares `major`.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` is `patch`.

## Acceptance notes

- `MetadataDraftHeader`, the declared return element of `listDrafts()`, still has no `member`, although the spec row declares it. The hook reads rows through `as any[]`, so nothing here needed the type. Widening it is a second public-type change outside this card's file surface (`publishDraft` only). Carrier: none.
- The advisory event that `publishDraft` emits names `type` and `name` but not the member. So an advisory on a `zh-CN` publish reads as the template's, not the language's. This is presentation only. It stays out of scope by the dispatch's "no other client method changes". Carrier: none.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
